echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance
echo_sets.note: Tailor-made for her: 20% Crit Rate when she applies Spectro Frazzle, plus Spectro DMG Bonus that scales with Frazzle stacks. Nightmare: Mourning Aix boosts Spectro DMG by 12% and deals more damage to Frazzle-affected enemies. One conflict: Game8's Aug 2026 update now recommends Capitaneus as the main Echo instead.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: A workable placeholder before Eternal Radiance is farmed. It offers general Spectro DMG, but lacks the Frazzle buffs.

build.energy_regen_target: 125-130% via substats (110-120% acceptable for Absolution DPS per some sources)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Luminous Hymn (her signature; Stringmaster or Cosmic Ripples otherwise) + 5-piece Eternal Radiance in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Go Crit Rate or Crit DMG on the 4-cost, Spectro DMG Bonus on both 3-costs, and ATK% on both 1-costs. Aim for ~125% Energy Regen from substats. Her damage collapses without Spectro Frazzle on the target, so always pair her with a Frazzle applier like Spectro Rover or Zani.

ranked_weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit Rate substat, with ATK plus Basic and Heavy Attack DMG against Frazzle-affected enemies. Her Outro also boosts Spectro Frazzle damage by 30% for 30s.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Yinlin's weapon, and her best 5-star alternative. Big Crit Rate, plus All-Attribute DMG and ATK buffs that Phoebe uses extremely well.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: Zhezhi's signature. Multiple build guides rank it #3 for her: a strong general 5-star stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: From the standard banner, so it is accessible. ATK% substat, with a Basic Attack DMG bonus and some Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Ocean's Gift
ranked_weapons.note: An event-exclusive 4-star. It stacks Spectro DMG bonus when she damages Frazzle-affected enemies, tailored to her mechanic.

ranked_weapons.name: Augment
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's recommended 4-star alternative. An accessible rectifier when no 5-star is available.

stat_priorities.note: Balance the Crit ratio. Eternal Radiance already grants 20% Crit Rate when she applies Frazzle.
Spectro DMG Bonus on both 3-costs for her main-DPS role.

profile.role_note: She has two states: Confession (sub-DPS) and Absolution (DPS). She is the top Spectro Frazzle applier and Zani's best partner. Her personal damage is also strong in Absolution state.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Phoebe is on the 3.8 Starpath Reverbs II selector (Nov 12 - Dec 21, 2026), alongside Camellya, Roccia, and Brant. Pick her only if you are building around Spectro Frazzle: she is Zani's best partner and makes that team work. Otherwise she sits at A-tier, outside the current meta. Most accounts get far more from Shorekeeper in this selector.

members.note: The burst carry; detonates stacked Spectro Frazzle with her Redundant Energy mechanics.

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Confession-state Frazzle applicator; amplifies Frazzle so Zani can explode it.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing; fits the full-Spectro resonance.

teams.name: Premium: Zani + Phoebe + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Phoebe holds her Resonance Skill to enter Confession and stack and boost Spectro Frazzle. Zani builds Redundant Energy and sets off the Frazzle stacks for the main damage window. Shorekeeper keeps Stellarealm up for Crit buffs and healing.

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Absolution-state on-field DPS; needs Frazzle on the target at all times.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: The Frazzle applier Phoebe is built around; near-non-negotiable teammate.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Sustain and universal Crit buffs with barely any field time.

teams.name: Alternative: Phoebe + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Spectro Rover opens to apply Spectro Frazzle. Phoebe enters Absolution and takes the on-field window with Heavy Attack combos. Shorekeeper sets up Stellarealm and sets it off before swapping back to Rover. Never continue the rotation if Frazzle is not applied — Phoebe's damage collapses without it.
